_instructions: Storage settings shared by the API and loop. The encryption key stays private in the state root; only this switch ships here.

admin_database_encryption._instructions: true seals the administrator account's records with the installation key (default; a missing or invalid file also keeps encryption on). false lets the fixed admin account store new records as authenticated plaintext for troubleshooting; other accounts and secrets are always sealed and existing records stay readable either way. Saved from the administrator encryption page; adopted at the next write in each process.
